problem: Evidence-backed commercial opportunities were created but external follow-up still stopped at a human authorization gate.
decision: The user's explicit instruction authorizes Powerhouse to execute bounded autonomous outbound for existing relationships. Use supported Gmail delivery first; never invent unsupported LinkedIn DM capability.
safeguards: Only existing relationships with status in_gesprek, aangeboden or rust.
Fresh trigger evidence within 30 days and confidence at least 0.60.
Maximum five autonomous sends per day.
At most one successful email per person per 30 days.
Respect unsubscribe, opt-out, do-not-contact, complaint and negative-reply outcomes.
Provider acknowledgement is required before marking done; dedupe prevents duplicate sends.
unsupported_capabilities: LinkedIn direct messaging is not claimed unless a supported provider tool becomes available.
